data_fields.name: restore_percent
data_fields.donor_constant: supplied by caller, clamped 0-100 (values not read)

best_idea: On a verified death take a level-scaled share of the current level's XP interval into a pending record, let a revive win back a set share capped at the pre-death total, and never penalise a second death before the revive.
decision_why: Keep the pending record, the one-penalty-per-death guard and the capped restore; the loss curve and exemptions become data, and only a server-verified death writes the record (the Pit is a client and writes no XP).
acceptance: A server test asserts a verified zone death takes the level-scaled share once, a second death before revival takes nothing more, and a revive returns the configured share capped at the pre-death XP.
